title: जगत् उपाध्याय ‘प्रेक्षित’का कवितामा राष्ट्रप्रेम
nepali: बहुमुखी प्रतिभाका धनी जगत् उपाध्याय ‘प्रेक्षित’ले नेपाली साहित्यमा महत्वपूर्ण योगदान गरेका छन् । उनले कविता, निबन्ध, बालसाहित्य, समालोचना, शिक्षा, दर्शन आदि विविध क्षेत्रमा कलम चलाए तापनि उनी बालसाहित्यकार एवम् कविका रूपमा चिनिएका छन् । यस शोध लेखमा उनका आकुञ्चन, समयका छालहरू, म, माटो र मुटु कवितासङ्ग्रह तथा ज्वाला खण्डकाव्यमा अभिव्यक्त देशप्रेम एवम् राष्ट्रबोधको खोजी गरी विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यस शोध लेखका निम्ति आवश्यक पर्ने प्राथमिक तथा द्वितीयक दुवै प्रकारका सामग्री पुस्तकालय विधिको नमुना छनोट पद्धतिबाट सङ्कलन गरी राष्ट्रबोधको सैद्धान्तिक अवधारणामा केन्द्रित रहेर विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । बाहिरी मुलुकले देशका विभिन्न क्षेत्रमाथि हस्तक्षेप गर्दा त्यसको विरोध गर्नु मात्र राष्ट्रबोध एवम् राष्ट्रियता होइन, माटोप्रतिको मायाभावको अभिव्यक्ति, राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक सौन्दर्यको वर्णन, राष्ट्र कमजोर बनाउने तत्व घुसखोरी, कमिसनखोरी, भ्रष्टाचार, कालोबजारी आदि पनि राष्ट्रघाती कार्य हुन् । यस प्रकारका राष्ट्रघाती कार्यको तीव्र विरोध गर्दै समाज सुधारको अपेक्षा राख्नु पनि राष्ट्रियताको अभिव्यक्ति हो । राष्ट्रबोधसम्बन्धी यिनै अवधारणाका आधारमा कवि प्रेक्षितका कवितालाई विश्लेषण गर्दै उनीभित्रको राष्ट्रप्रेम प्रस्ट पार्न‘ नै यस शोधलेखको निष्कर्ष रहेको छ ।
american_english: Endowed with versatile talent, Jagat Upadhyaya "Prekshit" has made significant contributions to Nepali literature. Although he wielded his pen across various fields including poetry, essays, children's literature, literary criticism, education, and philosophy, he is recognized as a children's author and poet. In this research article, the patriotism and national consciousness expressed in his poetry collections "Aakunchan," "Samayaka Chhalharu," and "Ma, Mato ra Mutu," as well as the narrative poem "Jwala," are explored and analyzed. Both primary and secondary materials required for this research article were collected using a sample selection technique under the library method and analyzed focusing on the theoretical concept of national consciousness. Protesting when foreign nations intervene in various domains of the country is not the sole aspect of national consciousness and nationalism; expressing affection for the soil, describing national natural beauty, and elements that weaken the nation—bribery, commission-taking, corruption, black-marketing, and the like—are also anti-national activities. Fiercely opposing such anti-national activities while maintaining the expectation of social reform is likewise an expression of nationalism. Analyzing poet Prekshit's poetry on the basis of these very concepts of national consciousness and clarifying the patriotism within him constitutes the conclusion of this research article.

informal_english: Gifted with versatile talent, Jagat Upadhyaya 'Prekshit' has made a really solid contribution to Nepali literature. Even though he tried his hand at poetry, essays, children's literature, criticism, education, and philosophy, people mainly recognize him as a children's author and poet. In this research paper, the patriotism and sense of nationhood brought out in his poetry collections 'Aakunchan', 'Samayaka Chhalharu', and 'Ma, Mato ra Mutu', along with his narrative poem 'Jwala', are explored and analyzed. All the required primary and secondary materials for this paper were collected through library sampling methods and analyzed focusing on the theoretical concept of national consciousness. Just protesting when foreign countries interfere in our matters is not the only sign of national consciousness and patriotism; showing love for the motherland, praising national natural beauty, and calling out things that weaken the nation like bribery, commission-taking, corruption, and black-marketing are also anti-national activities. Fiercely opposing such anti-national deeds while hoping for social reform is also an expression of nationalism. Analyzing poet Prekshit's poems based on these very concepts of national consciousness and bringing out the patriotism inside him is the final conclusion of this research paper.
